title: #30 Shopping Malls
prompt: In many towns and cities large shopping malls are replacing small local shops. Do you think this is a positive development? Give your reasons and examples.

promptSegments.text: In many towns and cities large shopping malls are replacing small local shops.
Do you think this is a positive development?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Shopping malls offer a wide variety of goods and services in one location, making them very convenient for customers.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Shopping malls offer a wide variety of goods and services in one location, making them very convenient for customers.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Malls contribute to the growth of the local economy by attracting people to spend money and creating jobs.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Malls contribute to the growth of the local economy by attracting people to spend money and creating jobs.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Shopping malls are bad for small local shops because they make it hard for them to survive.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Shopping malls are bad for small local shops because they make it hard for them to survive.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Shopping malls hurt the local economy because people spend money in big chains instead of small local stores.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Shopping malls hurt the local economy because people spend money in big chains instead of small local stores.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first benefit is the convenience that large shopping centres offer, as they provide a wide selection of goods and services in one place, eliminating the need for customers to travel to multiple locations.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first benefit is the convenience that large shopping centres offer, as they provide a wide selection of goods and services in one place, eliminating the need for customers to travel to multiple locations.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Secondly, malls help boost the local economy by attracting people who spend money there, which increases local tax revenue and funds public services.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Secondly, malls help boost the local economy by attracting people who spend money there, which increases local tax revenue and funds public services.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that the replacement of small local shops by large shopping malls is detrimental to community life and local economies.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that the replacement of small local shops by large shopping malls is detrimental to community life and local economies.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay highlights that local shops maintain unique community connections and character, which large malls fail to provide.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay highlights that local shops maintain unique community connections and character, which large malls fail to provide.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
